Description: Cottage Food Operation. Portable Pastries & Potage LLC is a Bakery in Berkeley, California, specializing in high-end baked goods, jams and confectionary items that do not require refrigeration. We are dedicated to providing high-quality, unique products for individual customers and restaurants in the Bay Area. Each item is made from scratch using mostly organic, farm-to-table ingredients largely sourced from local farmer’s markets and suppliers. Fresh, organic vegetables and fruits truly make a difference to our products, not only the taste, but also texturally and visually. These ingredients, wrapped in our homemade puff pastry or transformed in to jams or confectionary, enhance the unique experience for our customers. Portable Pastries & Potage couples their delicious products with exceptional customer service and accessibility. Our business is designed so customers will have a variety of ways to order our products; online for delivery, farmer's markets, and at various local restaurants. There will be no pick-up on site. All orders will be delivered, safely, to the customer as to keep the residential area free of extra traffic that the business may bring.

Description: 1) demolish the existing 5,424 square-foot, one-story commercial building at 1634 San Pablo Avenue and provide new surface parking for eight vehicles, 2) construct a 1,768 square-foot addition to the existing 4,566 square-foot, two-story commercial building at 1640 San Pablo Avenue, 3) erect two flour silos, and 4) construct an accessory trash enclosure in the required rear yard. The resulting 6,185 square-foot, two-story building at 1640 San Pablo Avenue would contain a food service establishment consisting of a café and bakery with incidental wholesale and retail sales of baked goods, as well as on-site customer seating.
